Write LaTeX representation of an equation or model

Source: R/write_latex.R
write_latex.Rd

Write LaTeX representation of an equation or model

Usage

write_latex(x, file, ...)

Arguments

x

An mm_equation or an mm_model.

file

Path to the output LaTeX file. For a model, NULL returns the LaTeX source instead of writing it.

...

Additional arguments passed to the specific method.

Value

For an mm_equation, invisibly file. For an mm_model, invisibly file when a path is given, otherwise the LaTeX source as a single character string.

Examples

tex <- write_latex(example_models$toy, file = NULL)
cat(substr(tex, 1, 600))
